8.14.1.7. iLock_Geography.geo_render.DotRenderer.renderTop¶

DotRenderer.renderTop(force=False)¶

Produces a string readable by the U{GraphViz<http://www.graphviz.org/>} program dot. This string will be rendered as a picture of the Area instance. To produce a pdf-file e.g., use the command line:

‘dot -Gcharset=latin1 -Tpdf <name>.dot > <name>.pdf’

Return type:string
Returns:A dot-readable string representing the Area graph.
